scope: All eight numbered native 1024px images viewed separately. Warmup excluded. Review is visual and subjective, not an attractiveness or identity classifier.
criteria: Recognizable priest appearance; exact Roman tab is not required. Full-size photographic quality, intact adult masculine face, bare head, calendar-style appeal and variety.

entries.notes: Smooth symmetric face with coherent eyes/irises and teeth, but evenly polished forehead, cheek gradients and repetitive beard texture produce a beauty-render appearance. Black open-neck ordinary button shirt has no clear clerical signal. Architectural background alone does not make the subject recognizable as a priest.

Coherent eyes, face and smile; pores and stubble are very uniform and skin has a polished plastic cast. Black/gray round-neck button shirt resembles ordinary casual clothing. Attractive portrait styling, but no recognizable clerical garment.

Coherent face and aligned irises. Very bright uniform teeth and glossy smooth cheek/forehead gradients look rendered or heavily retouched. Black high-neck garment with white inner collar reads as clerical, though neckline has an odd asymmetric cutout. No need to require a precise Roman tab. Bareheaded adult masculine appearance.

Eyes and face are structurally coherent; skin is evenly smoothed with synthetic-looking sheen and repeated fine texture. Black standing-collar robe with white inner neck fabric reads as a priest portrait without needing an exact tab. Strongly stylized handsome headshot, not convincing unretouched photography.

Face and eyes are intact; smile/teeth are very uniform. Skin and hairline have a polished illustration/render quality. Black standing-collar garment with white inner collar is recognizable as clerical or formal ecclesiastical clothing in this portrait; not rejected merely for lacking a small rectangular tab.

Coherent eyes and face, smooth almost metallic skin highlights and very uniform teeth. Black open standing-collar shirt without a white collar could be an ordinary formal shirt; priest identity is ambiguous. Subject is framed smaller, with substantial blank background, than other examples.

Most photographic-looking of the eight, with believable side gaze, ear, hair and beard geometry, but beard texture and skin remain unusually uniform/airbrushed. Regular white pointed shirt collar under black clothing and jacket reads as lay formal wear. No overt facial breakage; no recognizable priest signal.

Glasses, eyes and facial geometry remain coherent at full size. Hair, beard filaments and gray skin gradients are too uniform and sculpted to look convincingly natural. Black open-neck shirt and light jacket resemble ordinary portrait clothing. Cropped upper hair at frame edge, no hat; no clerical signal.

summary.major_problem: Consistent polished/rendered skin and repetitive synthetic microtexture; four outfits read as ordinary clothes and one is ambiguous. Facial geometry is substantially coherent, so this is not a gross eye-failure result.
summary.diversity: Across the eight there is visible variation in complexion, hairstyle, age impression, glasses and pose. Pairs 000/001, 002/003 and 004/005 share strong family resemblance and highly similar idealized smiles/headshot composition. 006 and 007 add older-looking facial hair, side view/glasses. Eight samples do not establish broad unseen-identity diversity; all have similarly lean handsome faces and limited natural asymmetry.
summary.recommendation: Do not deploy this two-step base unadapted. Retain as SDXL domain-adaptation comparator; evaluate whether a priest adapter improves garment identity and more photographic texture without damaging two-step inference. Do not infer that extra resolution alone improves realism.
